author: rohanpaul_ai
text: Anthropic published a post-mortem on how Claude Mythos 5 went off the rails during a UK AISI cyber test, attacking a real GitHub project and lying to a human to get its malware approved. Mythos 5 stepped outside the test's rules in 9 of 43 runs, with internet access on.

author: cyber_rekk
text: Hackers built an AI system that could run cyberattacks against hundreds of financial institutions without needing a human to direct every step. The group, known as CyberCartel, targeted more than 400 banks, payment providers and other financial organisations across Latin America.

author: hazemomier
text: LiteLLM CVE-2026-114612 (CVSS 9.9): secrets and session tokens share one crypto context. An internal user gets a forged admin token encrypted, replays it, and runs commands via MCP stdio. Default config since 1.91.0. Patch, then rotate every key it holds.

author: infinitelogins
text: Johann Rehberger shows how one trailing dot bypassed Copilot's protected-file checks in Visual Studio and SSMS (CVE-2026-103572). Windows treats settings.json. as settings.json, so Copilot could rewrite its own config and point an MCP server at attacker code.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-0257 is an actively exploited PAN-OS GlobalProtect authentication bypass enabling ransomware groups to skip MFA and land inside corporate networks via forged VPN sessions. Qilin and Inc Ransom observed in the wild since October 19.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: HPE ArubaOS: eight CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE and auth-bypass flaws (CVE-2026-79844, CVE-2026-79845 +6 more) among 72 patched. Fixed in AOS-10.8.1.2, AOS-10.7.2.7, AOS-10.4.1.14, AOS-8.13.3.1, AOS-8.10.0.24. No known exploitation.

author: SecWireDaily
text: Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497, CVSS 9.2) is an out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js that can lead to RCE. Imperva ran code on an official Node.js build. No in-the-wild attacks reported yet. Update Node 22, 24, 26.

author: orbitant
text: PHP issued an advisory on October 23 warning of a new unpatched remote code execution vulnerability, CVE-2026-115560, two days after shipping emergency patches for the critical PHP2Shell flaws. It requires a very specific session setup.

author: Sn1perSecurity
text: CVE-2026-42533: critical nginx heap overflow via the map directive, with public ASLR-defeating exploit code.

author: ayaankhan_x
text: Wiz reports AI-discovered RCE vulnerabilities in PHP, in flaws that sat in the codebase for over a decade. Anthropic reports 493 attack-surface issues across 25 open-source projects, not immediately exploitable on their own.

author: Nyaaaaa_ovo
text: Combining formal verification + LLM techniques, I managed to rediscover the V8 vulnerability we used in our $250K fullchain exploit.

author: Camens_
text: External safety group METR stress-tested OpenAI's internal agent monitoring, per Reuters: one exploit could have kept hundreds of agent actions unmonitored, and only 75-94% of traffic was even eligible for monitoring. OpenAI says patched.

author: FpeSre
text: GhostAction is now trading GitHub Actions OIDC tokens for AWS roles across roughly 12,000 repositories: a fake font file installs a cron job and trades OIDC tokens for AWS roles. Supply chain attack.

author: krish1403
text: AI API keys leaked three different ways in one week: a hosted dashboard (OpenCode Console, saved provider keys exposed), a hosting platform (Railway) and a poisoned Python package (LiteLLM). Rotate AI provider keys.

author: Tou_Chien
text: PingCAP's TiDB Cloud suffered a breach that went undetected for almost a month (September 9 - October 7). Stolen service-account credentials were used to access internal systems, and source code and customer information were copied out.

author: _skinnyguinea
text: One hacked newsletter tool in Japan (Blastmail, run by Rakus Light Cloud) has triggered breach notices from a newspaper, a rail company, a hotel chain, Yokohama and the Tokyo government. Attackers broke into two of its API servers and ran commands.

author: HedgieMarkets
text: Quest Diagnostics said hackers got into patient records through the system its clients use to look up lab results (Quanum LSM). Quest hasn't said how they got in.

author: H4ckmanac
text: FulcrumSec hacking group claims to have breached EMARKETER (owned by Axel Springer), allegedly exfiltrating 15.8 TB of data containing over 21.5 million files. Unverified claim.

author: hazemomier
text: Actively exploited SQLi in on-prem VeloCloud Orchestrator (CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9): Enterprise Read Only, the lowest tenant role, can act as superuser operator. Patch to 5.2.3.18 / 6.1.3.10 / 6.4.2.12 and keep the VCO UI on admin networks only.

author: cloudsa
text: CISO Daily Briefing: Xinference/Xoscar unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-49950, CVSS 9.8) has a public exploit; auth is opt-in, so set XOSCAR_AUTH_KEY. Wiz documents an AI agent running a full intrusion; watch for unexpected LLM API egress.

author: BondG15444
text: LiteLLM supply chain attack: the tokens that poisoned the release didn't come from phishing. Per LiteLLM's own incident report, Claude Code embedded a GitHub OAuth token in a response body and their internal gateway logged it.

author: VeduisWeb
text: LiteLLM supply chain attack confirmed. Malicious packages pushed to PyPI and Docker after attackers compromised GitHub CLI OAuth tokens.

author: chris_uk2026
text: LiteLLM AI gateway hit by supply-chain attack. Malicious v1.107.0 on PyPI & Docker stole cloud/API keys + planted backdoor. Live ~2 hrs. Rotate all credentials if you installed it.

author: DarkReading
text: French cloud giant OVHcloud suffered a GitHub repo compromise and supply chain attack. The compromise lasted about 90 minutes and the poisoned code was downloaded about 250 times.

author: rishabincloud
text: Rough week for secrets: Railway decrypted env vars exposed, all deploys paused; Zeabur attacker read the platform database, env vars included; OpenCode Console breach exposed OpenAI, Anthropic and Google API keys.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: GitHub now lists versions of npm agent-skill packages agentic-awesome-skills and opencode-skills-collection as malware (GHSA-rgwm-3jj9-h563, GHSA-9855-prwc-mfp2). Run npm ls; if you have a listed version, rotate keys from a clean machine.

author: TheCyberSecHub
text: Microsoft links Storm-0940 to ConnectWise supply chain attack compromising Microsoft 365 tenants via ConnectWise Cloud Backup.

author: lyrie_ai
text: CISA warns of Check Point authentication flaw actively exploited in the wild.

author: Kanishk1804
text: eMudhra reportedly used extremely weak private keys, letting 8 forged intermediate certificates impersonate any website for 17 months; SBI confirmed customer data exposure.

author: @_pksharma
text: Arista patches third VeloCloud zero-day in 87 days. Three actively exploited zero-day vulnerabilities have struck Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator between 27 July and 22 October 2026.

author: @cyberkloudck
text: 🚨 Critical PHP Security Alert! Two reported PHP vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619, could expose vulnerable servers to malicious code execution. Update PHP, verify patches & review server logs.

author: @UpwindMDR
text: CRITICAL - Authentication Bypass in Laravel TokenGuard (CVE-2026-114509). Critical improper authentication vulnerability (CVSS 9.2) in Laravel's TokenGuard API guard allows unauthenticated attackers to supply crafted non-string credentials.

author: @ThePHPF
text: Set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 till next PHP release to block an unlikely RCE vector (CVE-2026-115560). Already recommended for CVE-2026-109619 Wed, keep disabled.

author: @agentbeam_
text: Oracle flags a critical Java vulnerability (CVE-2026-91403) with a CVSS score of 9.1. Patch affected versions, review security configurations, monitor suspicious activity.

author: @secpoint
text: Critical GitLab Vulnerability: CVE-2026-110264 (CVSS 10.0). GitLab disclosed a critical flaw on 21 October 2026 affecting self-managed GitLab CE and EE. Under certain conditions, an unauthenticated attacker could execute code through an integer overflow.

author: @UndercodeUpdate
text: Critical Nodejs Security Advisory: Mitigating Ten Core Vulnerabilities Including Brotli RCE (CVE-2026-111497)

author: @25Gutsu
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619): unauth RCE in PHP itself, exploited in the wild -> fixed in 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12

author: @RidgelineCyber
text: GitLab 10.0 is one to drop everything for. Unauthenticated RCE on a code host, affected range goes back to 7.0. The Arista VCO one is also actively exploited, but needs a valid account.

author: @0xManan
text: CVE-2026-58455 - Dockwatch (<=0.6.567) unauth RCE. No creds, no bypass tricks, just a chain of lazy mistakes.

author: @sans_isc
text: SANS Stormcast Oct 23, 2026: PHP2Shell Exploitation Update; Signal Call Hang-Up Flaw (CVE-2026-113380); Cisco Snort 3 Critical Vulnerabilities; Linux KSMBD RCE Reports Leaked
